reason: Reviewed lifecycle guidance, shipped skill and references, harness setup, CLI readiness, README and domain terms. Codex ask now links a native request_user_input_async form only when the session's app-server can be reached to steer a device answer into the turn; otherwise it returns native_question_unavailable telling the agent to ask in plain text and keep transport details from the user. The native-questions reference names the new prerequisite and points at that field. Doctor gains a non-blocking Codex shared app-server report with a version-drift remedy. Hook output, answer delivery, acknowledgement and the steer path are unchanged. The ask-time transport preflight budget is 3 s so a cold Codex spawn is not misread as an absent server; agent-facing text is unchanged. The Codex control connection now uses a Unix-socket WebSocket client that works in the Bun-compiled runtime; agent-facing text is unchanged.
